017package org.apache.juneau.rest.server.mcp;
018
019import static org.apache.juneau.commons.utils.Shorts.*;
020import static org.apache.juneau.commons.utils.StringUtils.*;
021
022import java.util.Optional;
023import java.util.concurrent.*;
024
025/**
026 * Default {@link McpSubscriptionBroker}: a {@link ConcurrentHashMap}-backed registry doing filtered fan-out.
027 *
028 * <p>
029 * Publish methods ({@link #resourceUpdated}, {@link #toolsListChanged}, {@link #promptsListChanged},
030 * {@link #resourcesListChanged}) build one {@link McpChangeEvent} and iterate the live registry, offering the
031 * event only to subscriptions whose {@link McpSubscriptionFilter#matches(McpChangeEvent)} returns
032 * {@code true} — this never broadcasts unconditionally the way
033 * {@code org.apache.juneau.rest.server.sse.SseBroadcaster#publish} does.
034 */
035public class BasicMcpSubscriptionBroker implements McpSubscriptionBroker {
036
037   private final int queueSize;
038   private final ConcurrentMap<String,BasicMcpSubscription> subscriptions = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
039   // Guards the check-then-mutate window in registerIfUnder only; plain register() is intentionally
040   // uncapped and does not synchronize on this (see the interface javadoc for the split rationale).
041   private final Object admissionLock = new Object();
042
043   /**
044    * Creates a new broker.
045    *
046    * @param queueSize The per-subscription drop-oldest queue bound. Must be {@code > 0}.
047    * @throws IllegalArgumentException If {@code queueSize} is not {@code > 0}.
048    */
049   public BasicMcpSubscriptionBroker(int queueSize) {
050      if (queueSize <= 0)
051         throw iaex("queueSize %s must be > 0", queueSize);
052      this.queueSize = queueSize;
053   }
054
055   @Override
056   @SuppressWarnings({
057      "resource" // Returned subscription is caller-owned and closed by the caller/framework; Eclipse JDT @Owning warning is by design.
058   })
059   public McpSubscription register(String subscriptionId, McpSubscriptionFilter honoredFilter) {
060      if (isEmpty(subscriptionId))
061         throw iaex("subscriptionId must not be null or empty");
062      if (honoredFilter == null)
063         throw iaex("honoredFilter must not be null");
064      return doRegister(subscriptionId, honoredFilter);
065   }
066
067   @Override
068   public Optional<McpSubscription> registerIfUnder(int max, String subscriptionId, McpSubscriptionFilter honoredFilter) {
069      if (isEmpty(subscriptionId))
070         throw iaex("subscriptionId must not be null or empty");
071      if (honoredFilter == null)
072         throw iaex("honoredFilter must not be null");
073      // The size check and the put must be indivisible from the perspective of concurrent registerIfUnder
074      // callers, or two racers can each observe activeCount() < max and both register, exceeding the cap.
075      synchronized (admissionLock) {
076         if (! subscriptions.containsKey(subscriptionId) && subscriptions.size() >= max)
077            return Optional.empty();
078         @SuppressWarnings({
079            "resource" // Returned subscription is caller-owned and closed by the caller/framework; Eclipse JDT @Owning warning is by design.
080         })
081         var sub = doRegister(subscriptionId, honoredFilter);
082         return Optional.of(sub);
083      }
084   }
085
086   @SuppressWarnings({
087      "resource" // Returned subscription is caller-owned and closed by the caller/framework; Eclipse JDT @Owning warning is by design.
088   })
089   private McpSubscription doRegister(String subscriptionId, McpSubscriptionFilter honoredFilter) {
090      // The close callback removes this exact instance only (via the two-arg conditional ConcurrentMap.remove),
091      // so closing a stale/replaced subscription can never evict the fresher one that has since replaced it.
092      var sub = new BasicMcpSubscription(subscriptionId, honoredFilter, queueSize,
093         closed -> subscriptions.remove(subscriptionId, closed));
094      var previous = subscriptions.put(subscriptionId, sub);
095      if (previous != null)
096         previous.close();
097      return sub;
098   }
099
100   @Override
101   public void unregister(String subscriptionId) {
102      if (subscriptionId == null)
103         throw iaex("subscriptionId must not be null");
104      var sub = subscriptions.remove(subscriptionId);
105      if (sub != null)
106         sub.close();
107   }
108
109   @Override
110   public int activeCount() {
111      return subscriptions.size();
112   }
113
114   @Override
115   public void resourceUpdated(String uri) {
116      if (uri == null)
117         throw iaex("uri must not be null");
118      publish(new McpChangeEvent(McpChangeKind.RESOURCE_UPDATED, uri));
119   }
120
121   @Override
122   public void toolsListChanged() {
123      publish(new McpChangeEvent(McpChangeKind.TOOLS_LIST_CHANGED, null));
124   }
125
126   @Override
127   public void promptsListChanged() {
128      publish(new McpChangeEvent(McpChangeKind.PROMPTS_LIST_CHANGED, null));
129   }
130
131   @Override
132   public void resourcesListChanged() {
133      publish(new McpChangeEvent(McpChangeKind.RESOURCES_LIST_CHANGED, null));
134   }
135
136   private void publish(McpChangeEvent event) {
137      for (var sub : subscriptions.values())
138         if (sub.getFilter().matches(event))
139            sub.offer(event);
140   }
141}
